newsitem.title: UK: CE says Northern holders to get money Monday.
newsitem.headline: CE says Northern holders to get money Monday.

text.p: CE Electric UK Plc, a unit of CalEnergy Co Inc of the U.S., said in a statement that holders of Northern Electric shares who accept its hostile takeover offer by the closing on Friday will get their cash on Monday.
"CE Electric, if succesful, will settle all valid acceptances of the final ordinary offer for 650 pence cash that are received by 1300 on Friday by no later than Monday," CE said.
Britain's Takeover Panel said earlier that it had cleared the purchase of a 2.32 percent stake in Northern by brokers BZW and Schroders, who are advising Northern.
"I hope shareholders take note of this ruling as they will be deprived of the 650 pence we are offering," said a spokesman for CS First Boston, which is advising CE.
BZW and Schroders paid 645 pence for the stake in Northern.
"This conduct in CE's view clearly represents undesirable bid manipulation by defending advisors Schroders and BZW," CE said.
